source.adql:
SELECT source_id, ra, dec, ra_error, dec_error, parallax, parallax_error, pmra, pmra_error, pmdec, pmdec_error, phot_g_mean_mag, phot_bp_mean_mag, phot_rp_mean_mag, phot_bp_rp_excess_factor, ruwe, ipd_frac_multi_peak, adoptedrv, adoptedrv_error, adoptedrv_refname, radial_velocity_is_valid, gcns_prob, wd_prob, dist_1, dist_16, dist_50, dist_84, xcoord_16, xcoord_50, xcoord_84, ycoord_16, ycoord_50, ycoord_84, zcoord_16, zcoord_50, zcoord_84
FROM gcns.main
WHERE (xcoord_16 <= 6.132027876026 OR xcoord_84 <= 6.132027876026)
  AND (xcoord_16 >= -6.132027876026 OR xcoord_84 >= -6.132027876026)
  AND (ycoord_16 <= 6.132027876026 OR ycoord_84 <= 6.132027876026)
  AND (ycoord_16 >= -6.132027876026 OR ycoord_84 >= -6.132027876026)
  AND (zcoord_16 <= 6.132027876026 OR zcoord_84 <= 6.132027876026)
  AND (zcoord_16 >= -6.132027876026 OR zcoord_84 >= -6.132027876026)
ORDER BY source_id
